_note: ESTIMATE. Public list prices as understood on the fetch date below; NOT fetched from a billing API and NOT verified against an invoice. Verify against current pricing before quoting any usd figure. A wrong entry here changes every `tok` and `usd_micro` in the ledger and nothing will notice.
_source: public list pricing, from model knowledge; no network call was made

_units.usd_micro_per_token: millionths of a US dollar per token; $3/MTok == 3 usd_micro/token
_units.weight: billable-equivalent multiplier used to compute `tok`, normalised so that 1 tok == 1 token of `reference_usd_micro_per_token` input. Currently weight == usd_micro_per_token / reference, i.e. `tok` and `usd_micro` are proportional; they are stored separately so a future non-price weighting can diverge without a schema change.

class_multipliers._note: multiplier on the model's INPUT price. cache writes cost more than a plain input token; cache reads cost ~10x less; output is priced separately per model and is NOT derived from this table.

_default._note: unknown models are priced as the mid tier so an unrecognised model is never silently free.
